records.label: spacr.qt.screens.distributed_jobs.DistributedJobsScreen.closeEvent#1
records.source: ``requestInterruption`` alone has no effect — ``_run_operation`` never polls it — and would leave the screen's REST calls running with no owner. An ownerless job stays in the process-wide run registry, which is what ``MainWindow.closeEvent`` consults when it decides whether the application may quit.
